::: lead
This book collects well-documented R functions and hands-on workflows to support research data management (RDM) in practice — from ingest and validation to metadata enrichment, curation, and reporting.
:::

#| label: setup

> **How to read this book:** Each chapter introduces a task area (e.g., ingest, quality control). For each function, you’ll find its purpose, arguments, return value, examples, tests, and references. Copy/paste-ready snippets are provided in callouts.

::: callout-tip
**Reproducibility first.** All examples rely on versioned functions in `R/` with deterministic behavior and unit tests where applicable.
:::
